$comment: Top-level `wsync` commands that are actually implemented in the binary today.
This is a hand-maintained manifest, not a generated file. The command registry
under docs/commands/ describes the FULL Design-10.2 surface (71 commands) and is
deliberately ahead of the implementation; this file records where the engine
actually is, so check-command-validation.mjs can tell 'not built yet' apart from
'documented wrong'.
UPDATE THIS FILE IN THE SAME CHANGE THAT LANDS A COMMAND. Adding a variant to
`enum Commands` in src/cli/mod.rs without adding it here makes the `--bin` mode
of check-command-validation.mjs fail (advertised but not in the manifest), and
the classify mode print a stale-manifest warning.
Every name here must also exist in docs/commands/<name>.json.
As of Design 15 Phase 2: the twelve Argon-inherited commands plus daemon, watch, and install.
Phase 5 adds the read-only live surface (handshake/diagnostics, inspection,
search, reflection, session state, source) plus the conflict/decision commands,
the live write surface (set/new/rm/mv/attr/tag/call/eval and the
save/waypoint/undo/redo change-history family), the path tools (path/meta/where),
the registry surface (commands/context, plus the tail alias-command), the
cross-project clipboard (copy/paste), capture, the agent runtime
(playtest, run workflows), plan, refresh (with the plugin-connect
auto-refresh), auth, and the small aliases/exports
(snapshot/changes/services/open).
Phase 6 completes the surface: lint and repair (maintenance), the Open
Cloud group (upload, monetization), and transmit.
